scientific_basis: Ross 2003 uses a mixed dependent-variable strategy: water-content/saturation representation in unsaturated regions and pressure-head-type representation in saturated regions. SWAP5 must preserve a physical pressure degree of freedom where saturated water content alone cannot determine head.

persistent_physical_state_options.name: UNIFIED_HEAD_STATE
persistent_physical_state_options.advantage: fixed-size simple SoA layout and saturated-head state always retained
persistent_physical_state_options.risk: the Ross update is naturally expressed with a mixed variable, so conversion/update algebra may lose some of the original conditioning advantage unless handled carefully

persistent_physical_state_options.name: MIXED_Ross_STATE
persistent_physical_state_options.advantage: closest to the numerical structure documented by Ross
persistent_physical_state_options.risk: mode transitions and vectorized storage layout are more complex; exact transition conservation must be proven

admission_rule_for_state: Do not choose between unified-head and mixed-state layouts on presumed speed. First reproduce Ross equations, then prove identical physical state, exact storage accounting across saturation transitions and bounded vectorizable cost.
shared_immutable_parameter_data: precomputed steady-flux or correction tables only if separately qualified
worker_scratch: tridiagonal linear-system coefficients and solution vector
heterogeneous-interface brackets/local root state if required
important_runtime_point: Non-iterative does not mean no solve. The Ross lineage forms a linear/tridiagonal update and may also require constitutive integration/inversion and local interface work. These belong to bounded per-step or worker scratch, not persistent column state.

advance_trial_interface.signature: advance_trial(base_state, parameters, forcing, boundaries, t0, t1, physical_config, numerical_config, workspace) -> trial_result

top: realized infiltration/ponding-coupled flux or head through shared surface contract
evaporation/surface sink through owning process contract
boundary_contract.direct_groundwater: imposed H_MF is boundary data; solver returns one conservative bottom q_SWAP and coupling checks q_SWAP=-q_MF
boundary_contract.deep_vadose: runtime may route bottom flux through separate transfer-zone component

process_facing_result: storage delta and exact mass ledger
mass_contract: One realized face flux is applied with opposite signs to adjacent control-volume ledgers. Boundary and sink/source terms appear exactly once. Saturated/unsaturated mode changes may not create a storage correction outside the ledger.
response_tangent_candidate: Differentiate the same linearized/tridiagonal accepted-step system or solve its tangent system using the already assembled/factorized coefficients where possible; local interface roots use implicit differentiation while the active regime is unchanged.
open_gates: heterogeneous interface uniqueness and bounded cost
